stories.title: Detroit police Assistant Chief Franklin Hayes suspended pending investigation
stories.summary: CBS News Detroit reached out to the Detroit Police Department, and a spokesperson declined to comment.

stories.title: Maps show Iowa lead dust plume drifting southwest into Missouri Wednesday after detonation, Army shares
stories.summary: Maps of the planned lead azide detonation in Middletown show the shaded area stretching from near Burlington toward Macon, Missouri, by noon Wednesday. The forecasts will change with the weather.

stories.title: Detroit Lions owner, chair emeritus Martha Firestone Ford dies at 101
stories.summary: Ford assumed full control of the team after the death of her husband, William Clay Ford, in 2014. She transitioned to emeritus status in 2020.

stories.title: Iran War Updates: Iran developing chemical weapons, Israeli defense minister says
stories.summary: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz said Iran was developing chemical weapons and left open the possibility of preemptive strikes if necessary.

stories.title: Longtime Wayne County Commissioner Glenn Anderson dies
stories.summary: Wayne County Commissioner Glenn Anderson, who has spent more than two decades in local and state government, has died, his family announced on Tuesday.

stories.title: Army to detonate lead azide explosives in Iowa Wednesday morning, officials say
stories.summary: A federal appeals court on Monday declined to block the Army from detonating explosives containing lead azide at a munitions plant in Iowa.

stories.title: Why the Army says it needs to detonate unstable, lead-filled explosives in Iowa and what's at risk
stories.summary: The U.S. Army plans to detonate 68 drums of lead azide in Iowa despite local leaders and residents raising concerns.

stories.title: City of Dearborn introduces first roundabout to curb reckless driving
stories.summary: The roundabout is located at Chase Road and Ruby Avenue.

stories.title: Dearborn gets its first roundabout
stories.summary: Drivers in Dearborn are adjusting to the city's first roundabout at one of the busiest intersections.

stories.title: Detroit man charged with unsafe storage of firearm in non-fatal shooting of 5-year-old nephew
stories.summary: A Detroit man has been charged with the unsafe storage of a handgun in the non-fatal shooting of his nephew, prosecutors say.

stories.title: Ecorse community leaders and volunteers team up to distribute 700 free turkeys
stories.summary: Community leaders and volunteers teamed up to distribute 700 free turkeys, giving families one less expense to worry about as they prepare for the holiday.

stories.title: Community leaders, volunteers distribute 700 turkeys in Ecorse
stories.summary: With grocery prices continuing to strain household budgets, hundreds of Ecorse residents received a helping hand Tuesday ahead of Thanksgiving.
